// Step 4: send the draft plus matched sources into the scoring prompt.
const matchedSources = Array.isArray($json.matched_sources) ? $json.matched_sources : [];
const matchedSourcesJson = JSON.stringify(matchedSources, null, 2);

// This prompt defines the rubric, thresholds, allowed evidence, and JSON output shape.
const comparePrompt = [
  'You are the SharedSpace AI Fact Verification Engine.',
  'Evaluate the submitted article using a strict 100-point trust system.',
  'You ONLY trust CNA and The Straits Times (ST).',
  'Use only the draft text, reference URL, and matched CNA/ST sources below.',
  'Return ONLY valid JSON. Do not add extra prose.',
  '',
  'VERDICT RULES:',
  '- 81 to 100 = auto_publish',
  '- 60 to 80 = needs_review',
  '- 0 to 59 = unreliable',
  '- Low-information articles cannot be auto_publish.',
  '- If a core claim is contradicted, the article cannot be auto_publish.',
  '',
  'SCORING:',
  '- A_factual_accuracy max 45',
  '- S_source_quality max 25',
  '- B_bias max 10',
  '- L_logic max 10',
  '- C_completeness max 10',
  '- Trust Score = A + S + B + L + C',
  '',
  'STRICT RULES:',
  '- Validate reference_url as trusted only if it is an exact CNA/ST article URL, not a homepage or section page.',
  '- Extract 2 to 8 factual claims only.',
  '- If fewer than 2 factual claims can be extracted, mark low_information and score down aggressively.',
  '- Claim match scores: 1.0 exact, 0.85 clear paraphrase, 0.5 partial, 0.2 weak/no direct support, 0.0 contradicted.',
  '- Source quality must be 0 if there is no trusted CNA/ST match.',
  '- If strong emotional language exists, bias must be low.',
  '- If the draft is too short or vague, logic/completeness must be low.',
  '- If unreliable, identify the false, misleading, or unsupported line(s) from the draft. Quote the exact line when possible.',
  '- Do not invent support. If support is missing, treat it as unsupported.',
  '',
  'Return this exact JSON shape:',
  '{',
  '  "confidence": 0.0,',
  '  "reference_valid": false,',
  '  "metrics": {',
  '    "A_factual_accuracy": 0,',
  '    "S_source_quality": 0,',
  '    "B_bias": 0,',
  '    "L_logic": 0,',
  '    "C_completeness": 0',
  '  },',
  '  "claims": [',
  '    {',
  '      "text": "",',
  '      "subject": "",',
  '      "value": "",',
  '      "time": "",',
  '      "match_score": 0.0,',
  '      "confidence": 0.0,',
  '      "source": "CNA | ST | CNA+ST | null",',
  '      "reason": "",',
  '      "importance": "core | minor"',
  '    }',
  '  ],',
  '  "source_validation": {',
  '    "cna_match": false,',
  '    "st_match": false',
  '  },',
  '  "flags": [],',
  '  "misinformation_highlights": [',
  '    {',
  '      "line": null,',
  '      "reason": "",',
  '      "source": null',
  '    }',
  '  ]',
  '}',
  '',
  'Allowed flags:',
  '- low_information',
  '- vague_claims',
  '- no_trusted_match',
  '- high_bias',
  '- missing_context',
  '- core_claim_contradicted',
  '- multiple_core_claims_contradicted',
  '- contradicted_by_cna_and_st',
  '',
  'REFERENCE URL:',
  $json.source_url || '[none]',
  '',
  'MATCHED SOURCES JSON:',
  matchedSourcesJson,
  '',
  'ARTICLE DRAFT:',
  $json.article_text || '[missing article text]'
].join('\n');

const compareRequest = {
  model: 'gpt-5-mini',
  reasoning: { effort: 'low' },
  text: {
    format: {
      type: 'json_schema',
      name: 'sharedspace_cna_st_score',
      strict: true,
      schema: {
        type: 'object',
        additionalProperties: false,
        properties: {
          confidence: { type: 'number' },
          reference_valid: { type: 'boolean' },
          metrics: {
            type: 'object',
            additionalProperties: false,
            properties: {
              A_factual_accuracy: { type: 'integer' },
              S_source_quality: { type: 'integer' },
              B_bias: { type: 'integer' },
              L_logic: { type: 'integer' },
              C_completeness: { type: 'integer' }
            },
            required: ['A_factual_accuracy', 'S_source_quality', 'B_bias', 'L_logic', 'C_completeness']
          },
          claims: {
            type: 'array',
            items: {
              type: 'object',
              additionalProperties: false,
              properties: {
                text: { type: 'string' },
                subject: { type: ['string', 'null'] },
                value: { type: ['string', 'null'] },
                time: { type: ['string', 'null'] },
                match_score: { type: 'number' },
                confidence: { type: 'number' },
                source: { type: ['string', 'null'] },
                reason: { type: 'string' },
                importance: { type: 'string' }
              },
              required: ['text', 'subject', 'value', 'time', 'match_score', 'confidence', 'source', 'reason', 'importance']
            }
          },
          source_validation: {
            type: 'object',
            additionalProperties: false,
            properties: {
              cna_match: { type: 'boolean' },
              st_match: { type: 'boolean' }
            },
            required: ['cna_match', 'st_match']
          },
          flags: {
            type: 'array',
            items: { type: 'string' }
          },
          misinformation_highlights: {
            type: 'array',
            items: {
              type: 'object',
              additionalProperties: false,
              properties: {
                line: { type: ['string', 'null'] },
                reason: { type: 'string' },
                source: { type: ['string', 'null'] }
              },
              required: ['line', 'reason', 'source']
            }
          }
        },
        required: ['confidence', 'reference_valid', 'metrics', 'claims', 'source_validation', 'flags', 'misinformation_highlights']
      }
    }
  },
  input: [
    {
      role: 'system',
      content: 'Return JSON only. Score the draft strictly using only the supplied CNA/ST evidence.'
    },
    {
      role: 'user',
      content: comparePrompt
    }
  ]
};

return [{ json: { ...$json, compare_request: compareRequest } }];
